newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize weaker in good volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize weaker in good volume.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was steady to weaker in good volume trade midsession Tuesday at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with harvest supply pressure pushing prices down, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Rosario lost $1 to $108. Traders said yields have been better than expected in southern croplands. Cash soybeans slipped in good turnover, with plenty of supply. FAS elevator soybeans in Rosario lost $4 to $300. Sunflower seed lost $2 in Rosario to $226 in moderate volume, with prices dragged down by lower soybeans. Wheat slipped $1 to $164 in Quequen, in slow end-of-season trade.
